content: {"episode_id":"ep-05079","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-97 denial of CPT 93271 (cardiac event monitoring) for this episode. The clinical indication note documents a patient with a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9) and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9), reporting intermittent episodes of dizziness and palpitations that are poorly correlated with standard ECG findings. Per the note, the cardiac event monitoring study is indicated to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other intermittent dysrhythmias that may be contributing to these transient neurological symptoms. We request reconsideration of the CO-97 determination and payment of the outstanding balance of 337.79."}
